title: Cancel the Combined Synopsis RFQ -19KU2026Q0005 - Independence Day Event: Lighting, Stage & Sound Setup
agency_path: STATE, DEPARTMENT OF.STATE, DEPARTMENT OF.US EMBASSY KUWAIT
detail_text: The Government hereby cancels this Combined Synopsis #19KU2026Q0005 in its entirety. No further action is required from vendors at this time. All proposals, quotations, or responses received in response to this notice are no longer under consideration. The Government reserves the right to reissue the requirement at a later date, if deemed necessary. We appreciate your interest in this requirement
